decision_rule.quantities: Delta_O = PPL(FC,ORIGINAL) - PPL(FR,ORIGINAL); for the valid alternative variants v (COMPACT, SHUFFLED): shift = max_{s,v} |PPL(s,v) - PPL(s,ORIGINAL)|, I = max_v |Delta(v) - Delta_O|, reversal = sign(Delta(v)) != sign(Delta_O) for any v; tau = 1e-4 x PPL_BF16
decision_rule.RUN-BLOCKED: a configuration is missing, the ORIGINAL four-layer regression does not reproduce the partial-PPL weights and PPL exactly, an installation / contamination check fails, or the ORIGINAL execution-order negative control fails without explanation
decision_rule.BATCH-VARIANT-INVALID: an alternative variant differs from ORIGINAL in token ids, position ids, attention mask semantics, model weights, dtype or inference configuration
decision_rule.BATCH-SENSITIVITY-DOMINANT: shift >= 0.5 |Delta_O| OR I >= 0.5 |Delta_O| OR any reversal
decision_rule.BATCH-SENSITIVITY-MODERATE: otherwise (measurable, below half of |Delta_O|, no reversal)

bootstrap_note: the window bootstrap measures evaluation-text variability for a FIXED pair of quantized models; it says nothing about calibration-batch sensitivity

semantics.position_ids_and_mask_identical: by construction: one set of layer kwargs (batch-1 causal mask, positions, rotary) broadcast over every batch; recorded in model_config.layer_kwargs
semantics.no_padding: every row is a full 512-token chunk (no pad tokens, no attention mask beyond causal)

weights_note: not exposed by the frozen solver (gptq_quantize returns only the dequantized matrix); the act-order permutation / group assignment is compared on the Hessian subset
